name: Nanochat-style mHC without attention value embeddings
tagline: Four streams, near-uniform initial reads and a learned final readout.
description: Four full-width streams, token-dependent mHC read and write and a learned final stream readout. Full causal attention uses no VE table or VE gates. Input smear is retained.
mechanism: Four streams and one RMS-normalized projection per sublayer
Learned sigmoid reads, post-write weights and a 20-iteration log-space Sinkhorn mix
Input-dependent final read from the four streams
limitations: Fixed research configuration with matched random output projection initialization. The paired local Chord and Standard histories share the prefix through update 1,000.
